recipe.visualDefinition: A studio portrait of three people framed within a white arched window, set against a solid deep purple background. The composition features bold, stylized 1970s typography at the top of the arch, with a distinct color-blocked border separating the central image from the dark field.
coreVisualRelationships: The white arch acts as a high-contrast stage for the subjects against the dark purple field.
The typography follows the curvature of the arch's top edge.
The subjects' clothing colors (blue, yellow, patterned) provide the primary color interest within the white space.
coreInvariants: Arched white central frame with a thin red/yellow outline
High-contrast studio lighting with soft shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three full-body figures positioned centrally, walking toward the viewer, scaled to fill the lower two-thirds of the arch.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central male figure in a dark blue suit acts as the vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large stylized header text, move down the arch to the subjects, and follow their forward motion toward the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant solid purple negative space surrounding the central arch.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm Orange and Red (Border and Text Outlines)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the purple field contrasted with high value (brightness) in the central arch.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold display serif with psychedelic influences
letterConstructionRules: Tight letter spacing with overlapping strokes
Arched baseline for the primary title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'D' and 'N' feature extended, curling serifs that interlock with adjacent characters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A highly decorative, curved display face paired with a more rigid, straight-line slab serif for readability.
graphicDevices: Multi-colored thin border following the arch shape

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s serif aesthetic and swash potential
Provides the necessary weight and rounded retro feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-body studio photograph of three people in 1970s fashion walking forward, isolated inside a white arched frame. The arch is surrounded by a solid deep purple background. The arch has a thin red and yellow border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, arched, psychedelic serif title at the top of the white frame with an orange gradient fill. Place a secondary straight-line slab serif name in blue below it.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, dark purple?
Does the text follow the curve of the arch?
Are the subjects fully contained within the white space?
Is the typography heavy and stylized in a 70s manner?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the arch is perfectly symmetrical.
Verify the purple background is a flat, solid color.
Check that the text does not touch the subjects.
Confirm the typography has the characteristic 70s 'heavy bottom' look.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + white arch frame + deep purple field + psychedelic arched typography = 70s Retro Album Aesthetic.
